note: Spec pass 2026-10-15: groupings by an agent from the claims it read. The universal-management finding rests mostly on one meta-analysis (Oliver, Wehby & Reschly 2011), split into four claims; Korpershoek et al. 2016 is the second synthesis. The second and third hubs reuse questions from the engagement and social-emotional-learning specs of this pass.

findings.question: Does a planned, whole-class management approach reduce disruptive behavior and raise engaged time compared with usual practice?
Does a warm, personal contact with the teacher go with, or raise, students' engagement?
Do SEL programmes also improve conduct, distress and academic achievement, and by how much?
